Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier entity details and PO onboarding checklist

Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for signing the Master Purchase Agreement last week. To get Acme into our vendor master and enable POs, our finance team needs a short packet of information. I’ve attached our supplier onboarding form to speed things up; below is a checklist of the minimum items that will unblock PO issuance and first payment: 

- Legal entity full name (as appears on tax forms)
- Entity type and tax ID / VAT number (W-9 or W-8 as applicable)
- Registered address and remittance address (if different)
- Primary AP contact name, email, and phone
- Bank details for ACH: account name, routing number, account number, and a voided check or bank letter (we accept bank-letter PDF)
- Preferred invoice delivery method (email to ap@redwood.ai or supplier portal)
- Any preferred PO reference (internal code)

If you can return the completed form and a signed W-9 by Friday we’ll create the supplier record and kick off the PO for the initial onboarding services. Laura, looping you to confirm whether we need any additional legal attestation for non-US entities. Dev — please hold off on issuing the PO until we confirm the supplier code.

Best,

Jordan Blake
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Perfect — thanks Oliver. The W-9 and bank letter are exactly what finance needs. Laura — can you confirm whether the cert of incorporation is required before supplier creation for a US domestic entity? If not, we’ll proceed with the record creation once we receive the completed onboarding form (Oliver will send it tomorrow).

Dev — once the supplier record is created, please set the payment terms to Net 30 and tag the record with "partner:acme" and region=us so the Console dashboards track their spend under the right account. I’ll push the draft PO into the procurement queue and assign to you for release after validation.

One other operational note: we try to set up a preferred PO alias for recurring partners (e.g., ACME-ONB-2027) so invoices reference it and auto-match in our ERP. If you have objections to Net 30 for the initial onboarding, flag them here.

Thanks —
Jordan
